scenario_description: Elena has accepted a morning substitute assignment at Indianola K-8 School on April 14. The district then offers her an optional afternoon coverage assignment at nearby Dominion Middle School, creating a chance to earn additional pay during a route that appears feasible. The opportunity becomes sufficiently observable in event3, when the morning end time, afternoon reporting time, and lack of a material handoff are confirmed; later messages add the pay amount, a response cutoff, and confirmation that the opening remains available. Proactive help could connect the two school records, check the travel window, add the second assignment to Elena's schedule, and coordinate her acceptance before the opening is given away.

parameter.subject: Morning substitute assignment confirmed for April 14
parameter.body: Your substitute assignment is confirmed for Tuesday, April 14, 2026, at Indianola K-8 School, 420 E 19th Avenue, Columbus, OH 43201. Report to the main office by 7:30 AM. The morning coverage is currently scheduled to end at 11:30 AM.

parameter.subject: Optional afternoon coverage opening on April 14
parameter.body: Dominion Middle School has an uncovered afternoon science class on Tuesday, April 14. The coverage runs from 12:15 PM to 3:30 PM, and the school is looking for a substitute who can report to the main office at 12:00 PM. Let me know if you may be available.

parameter.subject: Timing confirmed for Indianola coverage on April 14
parameter.body: The Indianola K-8 School assignment on April 14 will end at 11:15 AM rather than 11:30 AM. You will not need to carry materials to another site after dismissal. Dominion Middle School is at 330 E Dominion Boulevard, about a twelve-minute drive from Indianola under typical conditions, and asks afternoon substitutes to check in by noon.

parameter.subject: Pay and reply time for Dominion afternoon coverage
parameter.body: The Dominion afternoon coverage pays the standard half-day substitute rate of $ ninety-five. Please reply by 10:00 AM tomorrow if you want the assignment so I can enter it and notify the school. The opening is still available at this time.

parameter.content: I heard the Dominion afternoon opening is still unfilled. The science teacher will leave the lesson materials in Room 214, so the substitute can go straight from the office check-in to class.
